speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have chronic fatigue; to help narrow this down, have you noticed any specific triggers, such as lack of sleep, stress, or changes in your diet? Additionally, have you experienced any other symptoms like fever, weight loss, or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't noticed any specific triggers; I feel exhausted even after getting a full night's sleep. I also haven't had a fever, lost any weight, or experienced joint pain, though I do get occasional headaches.
